Question 5
?

Find the domain of the function f(x,y)=cos⁡x+y.

a
{(x,y)∈R2:0<x+y<2π}
b
{(x,y)∈R2:x+y≥0}
c
The domain is the entire xy-plane
d
{(x,y)∈R2:x+y≠0}
e
{(x,y)∈R2:x+y>0}
